data.long_meaning: Pronab is a Sanskrit name that means 'Gift of the Gods'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'pran' meaning 'life' and 'naba' meaning 'new'. This name is a reminder of the divine gift of life and the importance of living a virtuous and wise life. The name Pronab carries the meaning “Gift of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Pronab usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
